value.text: Audit results: --all flag: no hits. GH-651 workaround FOUND and REMOVED: normalizeCheckpoint() function in index.ts was signing bare relative windows (e.g. '7d' -> '-7d') because pm activity --from bare windows used to return empty. Removed the signing logic; function now just trims whitespace. Updated tests and README accordingly. GH-672/676/785/792/794: no hits, not applicable.
